Select the appropriate notification for the Basti Dawakhana 57-post recruitment or the NHM/NUHM 63-post recruitment.
Download the prescribed application form for the selected recruitment.
Fill in the required personal, educational, professional registration, experience and category details.
Enter local-area particulars carefully and attach the applicable study certificates.
Paste a recent photograph on the prescribed application and sign across it.
Prepare original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies.
Obtain the prescribed Rs. 500 Demand Draft from a nationalized bank in favour of the District Medical & Health Officer, Medchal-Malkajgiri.

Submit the completed application and required documents between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM during the notified application period.

Important Application Warning: Applicants must use the form and eligibility conditions corresponding to their chosen notification. Incomplete applications or applications submitted after the deadline will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the required post-wise educational qualifications, professional registration and experience, where applicable. Important Qualification Notice: A 10th Pass qualification is sufficient only for the notified Supporting Staff posts, subject to other eligibility rules. Applicants for healthcare and technical positions must satisfy the prescribed educational, registration and experience requirements. Candidates applying for regulated healthcare posts must possess the relevant registration with the competent Telangana professional council, where prescribed. Medical Officer - Telangana State Medical Council registration. Staff Nurse - Registration with the concerned Telangana Nursing Council. ANM - Prescribed nursing or MPHW registration. Lab Technician - Applicable Telangana Paramedical registration. Pharmacist - Telangana Pharmacy Council registration. MLHP/CHO/MO - Relevant council registration according to the qualification route. The Basti Dawakhana notification specifically requires Medical Officer applicants to obtain the valid Telangana Medical Council registration certificate by the application date.

rows.educational_qualification: MBBS with registration in the Telangana State Medical Council
MBBS with Telangana State Medical Council registration, BAMS with prescribed Indian Medicine registration, or B.Sc. Nursing with the required Nursing Council registration
B.Sc. Nursing, GNM, M.Sc. Nursing or GNM with Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, as applicable to the notified post, with the required Telangana Nursing Council registration

Prescribed Multi-Purpose Health Worker (Female) qualification and registration, or eligible Intermediate Vocational MPHW (Female) training with the specified clinical training/apprenticeship and registration
Intermediate (10+2) with prescribed Diploma/Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology or equivalent qualification and applicable paramedical registration
B.Pharmacy or Diploma in Pharmacy with the prescribed Telangana Pharmacy Council registration

Medical graduate with specified postgraduate qualification in Preventive and Social Medicine, Public Health or Epidemiology; or another notified qualification route with prescribed public-health experience
Graduate in the prescribed Dental/AYUSH/Nursing/Life Sciences/Social Science field with a relevant Master's degree and two years of specified health programme management experience
Postgraduate qualification with prescribed communication, public-private partnership or health-project experience and the specified two-wheeler driving requirement
MBA in Health Care or a prescribed postgraduate qualification with two years of health programme experience

content_sections.text: The notified monthly remuneration ranges from Rs. 15,600 to Rs. 52,000 , depending on the post and programme. content_sections.heading: DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: Both notifications prescribe a Rs. 500 registration fee through Demand Draft . The Demand Draft must be submitted with the relevant prescribed application and supporting documents. The supplied notifications do not specify category-wise fee exemptions or refund provisions. Candidates applying under both notifications should confirm any separate application and fee requirements with the recruitment authority.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on educational merit and age weightage, followed by the prescribed reservation, merit-list and certificate-verification procedures. After completing 18 years of age, applicants receive 0.5 mark for each completed year , up to a maximum of 10 marks. The notification date is used to calculate age-weightage marks. If two candidates obtain equal merit marks, the older candidate will receive a higher merit rank. Scrutiny of submitted applications and documents. Calculation of educational qualification marks and age weightage. Preparation of the provisional merit list. Consideration of objections and preparation of the applicable selection list. Application of reservation rules, local reservation and Presidential Orders. Certificate verification for shortlisted applicants. Final engagement subject to eligibility and approval of the recruiting authority. The notifications do not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Foreign medical graduates will be assessed under the notified FMGE-based merit calculation where applicable.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Contract Period 2026
content_sections.text: The appointments are temporary on a contractual or outsourcing basis for one year or until the actual requirement ceases, whichever is earlier . Key contractual conditions include: Contract employment does not confer any right to regular government appointment. Extension of the contract is at the discretion of the appointing authority. No pensionary benefits are admissible. Leave is governed by the prescribed temporary contractual rules. The notifications provide 120 days of maternity leave without pay for eligible women. Selected candidates must execute the prescribed agreement on non-judicial stamp paper worth Rs. 100. The recruiting authority may revise the number of posts, change deployment arrangements or cancel recruitment according to administrative requirements. The notifications state that original certificates will remain in the custody of the office during the contract period.

content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted offline in person between 23 and 28 October 2026, excluding Sunday, during the notified office hours. Visit the official Medchal Malkajgiri District website at medchal-malkajgiri.telangana.gov.in . Locate the relevant DMHO recruitment notification dated 19 October 2026. Select the appropriate notification for the Basti Dawakhana 57-post recruitment or the NHM/NUHM 63-post recruitment. Download the prescribed application form for the selected recruitment. Fill in the required personal, educational, professional registration, experience and category details. Enter local-area particulars carefully and attach the applicable study certificates. Paste a recent photograph on the prescribed application and sign across it. Prepare original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies. Obtain the prescribed Rs. 500 Demand Draft from a nationalized bank in favour of the District Medical & Health Officer, Medchal-Malkajgiri. Visit the Office of DMHO, F-1 IDOC Building, Anthaipally, Shamirpet. Submit the completed application and required documents between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM during the notified application period. Important Application Warning: Applicants must use the form and eligibility conditions corresponding to their chosen notification. Incomplete applications or applications submitted after the deadline will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Application Submission Address
content_sections.text: Office of the District Medical and Health Officer F-1 IDOC Building, Anthaipally, Shamirpet, Medchal Malkajgiri District, Telangana. Submission Dates: 23 to 28 October 2026, excluding Sunday. Submission Timings: 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DMHO Medchal Malkajgiri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must submit the relevant original certificates for verification along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Completed prescribed application form. SSC or equivalent certificate for proof of date of birth. Intermediate / 10+2 certificate. Relevant educational qualification certificates and year-wise or consolidated marks memos. Provisional or final qualification certificate, where applicable. Professional council registration certificate for healthcare and technical posts. Experience certificates for posts requiring relevant experience. Latest caste and community certificates, where applicable. EWS Certificate for financial year 2026-27, if claiming EWS reservation. SADAREM Disability Certificate, if applicable. Ex-servicemen or other reservation certificate, if applicable. Bonafide study certificates from Classes 1 to 7 for local-status claims. Recent photograph pasted on the application and signed across. Rs. 500 Demand Draft from a nationalized bank. Document Warning: Candidates who do not submit the prescribed study certificates will be treated as non-local. Candidates without the required caste certificate will be treated as OC, as specified in the notifications.
